aliases.gripper: (empty: no manipulator in the driving scene)

token_group_source.masks: hazard_mask (pedestrian or cone) and corridor_mask (ego-lane polygon ahead), [T,256,256] bool

contrasts.app_ped: mean_a (h[1,a] - h[0,a]) (action-averaged main effect; contains DiD(1)/2)
contrasts.app_ped_a0: h[1,0] - h[0,0] (brake-cell appearance = main effect - DiD/2; registered for test i)
contrasts.action: mean over hazard-free levels (0, 2) of (h[l,1] - h[l,0])
contrasts.rel_ped: DiD(1) - DiD(2), projected off the train-fold rank-k_action action main-effect subspace
contrasts.pooling: mean over the scene-level union of the group's tokens

transport.method: orthogonal Procrustes W = argmin ||X_A W - X_B||_F on matched per-token rows (same cell, step, token id) of the hazard-free cells (levels 0,2), centred on the train fold; LOSO: held-out scene removed from the cross-covariance and the means
transport.why_hazard_free: rows carrying the in-lane identity would let the d x d map absorb the contrast under test (synthetic null check)
transport.direction_map: column direction q in A -> W^T q in B; conceptor eigvecs V -> V W

registered_tests.unit: scene (pair_id); CIs = scene bootstrap of the mean; sign_flip_p = two-sided sign-flip of the per-scene LOSO scores (descriptive, approximate: scene i sits in every other fold); test (ii) uses a refit permutation null; max-T = Westfall-Young over the sites of a (step, group) family with shared flips
